step1_figure.description: A high-speed rail-to-rail comparator consisting of complementary NMOS and PMOS differential input pairs, PMOS current mirrors feeding an NMOS cross-coupled positive feedback decision circuit with an output shift device, followed by a PMOS differential amplifier stage and an inverter output buffer.

switching_point_hysteresis.description: Switching point voltage threshold and hysteresis

equation.explanation: Calculates the positive switching threshold VSPH and negative switching threshold VSPL of the decision circuit. When beta_A = beta_B (symmetric sizing), VSPH = VSPL = 0 V (no hysteresis).
equation.assumptions: M5/M8 have transconductance parameter beta_A, M6/M7 have beta_B; diff-pair tail current Iss and input transistor transconductance gm.

sky130_expected.calculation: In Fig. 27.9, all decision transistors M5-M8 are matched with W/L = 10/1 (beta_A = beta_B). Thus (beta_B/beta_A - 1) = 0, giving VSPH = 0 V and VSPL = 0 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Designed symmetrically without deliberate hysteresis; random mismatches in practice are typically < 5 mV.

dc_voltage_gain.description: Small-signal DC voltage gain at the switching threshold (slope of Vout vs Vp)

equation.explanation: Overall DC gain of the cascaded stages: input pre-amplifiers, positive feedback decision stage, differential amplifier, and inverter buffer.
equation.assumptions: Evaluated at the transition region where vp = vm.

sky130_expected.calculation: The textbook achieves Av ~ 175,000 (~105 dB) in 5V CMOS. In SKY130 1.8V with L=1um channel lengths, individual stage gains are roughly: Preamp Av1 ~ gm*ro ~ 15-20, Decision stage regeneration Av2 ~ 10-20, Diff-amp buffer Av3 ~ 20-30, Inverter Av4 ~ 15-25. Total gain Av = Av1 * Av2 * Av3 * Av4 ~ 50,000 - 150,000 (94 to 103 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: High cascaded gain ensures sharp digital switching with sub-millivolt input resolution.

equation.explanation: Difference between the input voltage at the comparator switching point (output crossing VDD/2) and the reference voltage vm.
equation.assumptions: Ideal matching between symmetric devices; offset originates from systematic asymmetries in biasing and stage single-ended conversions.

sky130_expected.calculation: Systematic offset arises primarily from the conversion from differential to single-ended in the post-amplifier and threshold shift of the inverter. Typically Vos is within a few millivolts.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Symmetric layout and balanced loads keep systematic Vos below 10 mV.

propagation_delay.description: Propagation delay from input differential zero-crossing to output 50% transition

equation.explanation: Time elapsed between the input crossing the threshold and the output transitioning through VDD/2, evaluated under a 50 mV overdrive pulse.
equation.assumptions: Narrow 10 ns pulse with 50 mV overdrive (vp stepping from 0.85V to 0.95V around vm = 0.9V).

sky130_expected.calculation: Textbook reports ~9 ns in 5V CMOS. In SKY130 (0.18um CMOS node, faster gm/C ratios), propagation delay is typically 2 ns to 8 ns under 50 mV overdrive.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Absence of compensation capacitors and positive-feedback decision circuit enables sub-10 ns propagation delay.

output_swing_voh_vol.description: Output high and low voltage levels

equation.explanation: The output buffer inverter restores signal levels to full rail-to-rail digital logic levels.

sky130_expected.reasoning: CMOS inverter drives fully to VDD and Ground under DC conditions.

quiescent_current_and_power.description: Total quiescent current drawn from VDD and total power consumption

equation.explanation: Sum of bias circuit current, NMOS input pair tail current, PMOS input pair tail current, folded mirrors, decision circuit currents, and output buffer diff-amp bias current.

sky130_expected.calculation: Bias generator draws ~40 uA. NMOS diff-pair: Iss ~ 20 uA. PMOS diff-pair: Iss ~ 20 uA. Decision circuit: 2 * 20 uA = 40 uA. Output buffer diff-pair: ~20 uA. Total Idd ≈ 140 uA. Power = 1.8V * 140 uA ≈ 252 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Multiple bias branches each biased at 20-40 uA for wide-bandwidth operation.

equation.explanation: Dual complementary NMOS and PMOS input differential pairs allow operation from 0 V to VDD.
equation.assumptions: At least one input differential pair remains active across the entire 0 to VDD range.

sky130_expected.calculation: NMOS pair operates from Vthn + Vov (~0.6V) to VDD. PMOS pair operates from 0V to VDD - |Vthp| - |Vov| (~1.2V). Their parallel combination covers 0V to 1.8V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Complementary topology is explicitly chosen for rail-to-rail common-mode coverage.

step3_testbench.description: Comprehensive ngspice testbench for Baker Fig. 27.9 rail-to-rail comparator measuring DC gain, systematic offset, output swing, quiescent power, and propagation delay under a 50 mV overdrive pulse.
